title: Joined-player admin access and TRP coin grant UI wiring

requirements.summary: Allow any authenticated user with a saved profile to access all /admin/* routes without admin denial.
acceptanceCriteria: A logged-in user with a saved profile can navigate to `/admin` and see `AdminHomePage` without being blocked by `AdminGuard`.
A logged-out user navigating to `/admin` still sees an access denied message prompting login.
Admin routes under `/admin/*` are consistently accessible to joined players (no inconsistent gating between pages).

file_operations.description: Update admin gating to treat a user as allowed if they are authenticated AND have a non-null caller user profile (joined player), while keeping logged-out users blocked. Use existing profile query logic consistent with the authorization component’s frontend guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Enable and wire the Admin "Grant TRP Coins" UI to the backend grantCoins call with success/error toasts and query invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: On `AdminEconomyToolsPage`, the principal input, amount input, and grant button are enabled for joined players.
Submitting a valid principal and amount calls the React Query mutation and triggers a backend request.
On success, a toast indicates the TRP coin grant succeeded and relevant profile queries are invalidated/refetched.
On failure, a toast displays a helpful error message (e.g., user not found).

file_operations.description: Implement `useAdminGrantTrpCoins` mutation to call the backend `grantCoins` function (parsing the target principal from text), convert backend success/error result into resolved/throwing behavior, and invalidate/refetch relevant profile queries on success. Align error handling with the authorization component’s guidance for trapped/returned errors; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Remove the temporary disabled state and 'Coming Soon/unavailable' messaging for the TRP coin grant section; enable inputs/button for joined players and keep existing validation. On mutation success show a confirmation toast; on mutation failure display the backend-provided error message via toast (or a fallback). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
